en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Abu Maryam Al Ansary, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘How was the (funeral) Salat upon the Prophetsaww?’

When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> washed him<sup>saww</sup> and enshrouded him<sup>saww</sup>, covered him<sup>saww</sup>. Then ten (people) came over to him<sup>saww</sup> and they circled around him<sup>saww</sup>. Then Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> paused in the middle of them and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
[33:56] Surely Allah and His Angels are Sending Blessings upon the Prophet; O you who believe! Send blessings upon him and submit to him with a (complete) submission’.
So the people were saying just as heasws was saying until the people of Al-Medina had prayed Salat upon himsaww, and (so did) the people of Al-Awaly’.
